title: Beagle Dog Tags for Nose-First Wanderers | Salty Dog Tags
description: Funny engraved beagle dog tags for the nose that never clocks out. Laser engraved in Lehi, Utah, from $12, with name and number on the back.
blurb: Engraved tags for a nose with a dog attached. Beagles follow a smell three blocks, bay about it, and come home when they feel like it. We respect the commitment.

hero.alt: Close-up of a laser-engraved dog tag: polished stainless bone with a paw cut-out, engraved WHISKY and a phone number
hero.figcaption: Whisky's actual tag. He's a bulldog, but the laser doesn't care what breed you are.

tough.h2: Built for a dog that goes wherever the smell goes
tough.html:
A beagle's tag spends its life an inch off the ground: through hedges, under porches, nose-first into every trash bag on the street. Printed tags lose that fight fast.

Our text is laser-cut into the metal. No ink on top, so dirt, brush and the occasional puddle don't take your phone number with them.

When the nose wins, the tag gets your beagle home.

How engraving holds up →

more.h2: Made by a house with seven bulldogs
more.lead: We're a family in Lehi, Utah with seven English bulldogs and one very busy laser. We wrote the bulldog tags first, from experience. The beagle lines come from neighbors whose beagles have personally visited our yard, uninvited, following something only they could smell.

What to Put on a Dog Tag

items.q: Will dirt and digging wear off the engraving?
items.a: No. The words are laser engraved into the metal, not printed on, so scuffs don't erase them.

items.q: Can I put my beagle's name and my phone number on the tag?
items.a: Yes. Saying on the front, name and phone number on the back. For a scent-chaser, a line like "Call mom. Bring cheese." also tells a finder how to catch them.

items.q: Do you have sayings written specifically for beagles?
items.a: Eight on this page, about the nose, the baying and the counter surfing. Each fits the tag as written.

items.q: What happens if the engraving comes out wrong?
items.a: If we mis-engrave it, we remake it free. Tags are engraved and shipped from Lehi, Utah in 1 to 2 business days, then USPS takes 3 to 5 days in transit. US only.
